interpretation.normalization: Q_engine=Q_external*sqrt(g_engine/g_external); n_engine=n_external*sqrt(g_external/g_engine). Preserves Q^2/g and (nQ)^2, hence depth/energy/friction equations. Velocity scales with Q.
interpretation.boundary: Use sampled cell-center boundary depth; no extrapolation to x=0/200. Both sides share the same truncated reach.
interpretation.note: External analytic hydraulic verification, not observed river calibration. Refined SWASHES bed output has integration/printing error. 8m banks and .01 normal-depth diagnostic slope are adapter settings.
